content.title: Arizona's NCAA Tournament run ends in Final Four loss to Michigan
content.text: April 4, 2026Updated April 6, 2026, 10:25 a.m. MTThe Arizona Wildcats faced the Michigan Wolverines in the second Final Four game of the 2026 NCAA Tournament on Saturday, April 4, 2026.What was the Arizona vs Michigan score in the national semifinals of March Madness?Who stood out?What were the key stats?Look back at our live score updates for news, notes, highlights and analysis from the game, which was played at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana, to find out how the game between the Wildcats and Wolverines went down.How to watch national championship game: UConn vs Michigan | Schedule | TV channels | Time | Streaming | AnnouncersWatch Arizona vs Michigan on Sling What was the Arizona vs Michigan score?The Michigan vs Arizona score in the Final Four game was Michigan 91, Arizona 73.National championship game picks: UConn vs Michigan | The Republic's score prediction | Win probabilities | Title projection Arizona's NCAA Tournament run ends in Final Four loss to MichiganThe Arizona Wildcats' quest for a second national championship ended two wins short.Arizona was dominated by Michigan in a 91-73 loss to the Wolverines at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.Arizona trailed by as many as 30 in the second half. They never led in the game.Michigan shot 48% from the field in the game and 44% from 3-point range. It played strong defense, limiting the Wildcats to 37% shooting from the field and 35% from 3-point range.Arizona finished the season 36-3 and as the Big 12 regular season and Big 12 Tournament champions.Michigan, 36-3, will take on UConn in the national championship game on April 6.Final score: Michigan 91, Arizona 73National championship game odds: UConn vs Michigan | Title odds | Betting odds Michigan nears win vs Arizona in Final FourThe Wolverines are just a few minutes away from the national championship game.Michigan leads Arizona in the Final Four, 86-64, with 4:30 remaining.They have dominated the Wildcats tonight.Aday Mara is up to 26 points on 11-for-15 shooting for Michigan. He has eight rebounds.Score: Michigan 86, Arizona 64 (4:30 left in second half) Arizona cuts Michigan lead to 21 in Final FourThe Wildcats have trailed by as many as 30 in this game.They are now down by 21.But there is just 7:33 left in the second half.Brayden Burries is up to 13 points for Arizona after having just two at the half. Koa Peat leads the Wildcats with 14.You have to like the effort with Arizona not giving up. But that clock is running down fast in Indianapolis.Score: Michigan 81, Arizona 60 (7:15 left in second half) Michigan pouring it on vs Arizona in Final FourThe Wolverines have led by as much as 29 points in this game.Depending on the sportsbook, they were a 1.,5 underdog or a 1.5 favorite in odds before tip off against the Wildcats.Talk about an impressive performance so far.Elliott Cadeau has 10 assists for the Wolverines, whose guards have just destroyed Arizona's guards.Michigan is 35-3. 28 of the Wolverines wins have been by double figures.They appear on their way to a big win at the Final Four.Score: Michigan 74, Arizona 47 (10:47 left in second half) Michigan destroying Arizona with 3-pointers in Final FourMichigan is on fire from 3 in the second half, having hit several big shots from long distance.The Wolverines are now 11-for-24 from 3 in this game.They are 26-for-54 from the field.Arizona is 17-for-48 from the field and 4-for-10 from 3.Elliot Cadeau is just 4-for-16 from the field in this game, but he is 3-for-7 from 3. Trey McKenney is 3-for-5 from 3. Yaxel Lendeborg is 3-for-3.This game is getting very ugly as the Wolverines are pouring it on against the Wildcats.Score: Michigan 72, Arizona 45 (12:17 left in second half) Michigan's Yaxel Lendeborg making presence felt vs ArizonaYaxel Lendeborg missed most of the first half with an ankle injury and a knee injury.But that's not impacting his 3-point shooting.The Michigan star has two big 3-pointers in the second half, helping the Wolverines increase their lead to 56-39.They have led by as much as 22.Lendeborg now has 11 points in the game on 3-for-4 shooting. He is 3-for-3 from 3. He has played just 10 minutes.Score: Michigan 56, Arizona 39 (15:40 left in second half) Arizona needs Brayden Burries to step up vs MichiganBrayden Burries is averaging almost 18 points per game in the NCAA Tournament.The dynamic Arizona freshman has just two points in this game against Michigan.He is 0-for-8 from the field and 0-for-4 from 3 in this game. Can he get something going for the Wildcats in the second half?Yaxel Lendeborg started the second half for Michigan, giving it a go on a bad ankle. He made his presence felt with a 3 that extended Michigan's lead to 53-34.Score: Michigan 53, Arizona 34 (16:42 left in second half) Michigan takes 16-point lead into half vs Arizona at Final FourThe Arizona Wildcats' largest halftime deficit of the season before today was seven points.At the Final Four at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana, Tommy Lloyd's team trails Michigan by 16 points.Arizona has some work to do to try to get back in this game.The Wildcats made 12 field goals in the first half (they shot just 12-for-32). They had nine turnovers. They only had two assists.Michigan, in contrast, was 17-for-41 from the field, with 12 assists and four turnovers, and they did it only getting five minutes out of star Yaxel Lendeborg, who had foul trouble early and then exited the game with an ankle injury.Aday Mara led the Wolverines with 15 points.Koa Peat, Mo Krivas and Tobe Awaka each had six points for Arizona in the first half.Jaden Bradley played only 11 minutes in the first half and has three fouls.Halftime score: Michigan 48, Arizona 32 Aday Mara shining for Michigan vs Arizona in Final Four gameAday Mara is having himself a game for Michigan.He has 15 points in 13 minutes on 6-for-8 shooting, with five rebounds and has been a catalyst for the Wolverines, who are doing this with Yaxel Lendeborg out with an ankle injury.Score: Michigan 48, Arizona 32 (:26 left in first half) Michigan maintaining lead against Arizona in Final FourTracy Wolfson reported that Yaxel Lendeborg was going to receive more treatment in the locker room for his ankle, the same ankle he injured in the Big Ten Tournament, with the hope that he would be able to get back in the game in the second half.Michigan is doing fine without him right now.The Wolverines are up by 13. Six players have five points and one player (Aday Mara) has eight. Talk about balanced scoring.Michigan is 13-for-32 from the field and 5-for-12 from 3.Arizona is 9-for-25 from the field and 2-for-5 from 3.Score: Michigan 38, Arizona 25 (3:04 left in first half) Michigan adds to Final Four game lead after Arizona runYaxel Lendeborg was just shown walking back to the Michigan bench, which was a good sign for Michigan.Not a good sign? He had a towel over his head and was walking gingerly. Later, he was shown walking back to the locker room for the Wolverines.Well continue to monitor his situation, but the Wolverines are hanging tough without him.They are more than hanging tough. They are thriving. Michigan withstood a 9-0 Arizona run to build the lead back to 12.Michigan leads 35-23 with 4:35 left in the first half.Bad news for Arizona? Jaden Bradley picked up his third foul, and his second offensive foul of the game, with 5:09 left in the first half.Score: Michigan 35, Arizona 23 (4:35 left in first half) Michigan's Yaxel Lendeborg exits game vs Arizona with ankle injuryYaxel Lendeborg landed awkwardly for Michigan on a drive to the basket, providing a scare for Wolverines fans and was later seen headed to the locker room.Tracy Wolfson reported on the broadcast that the Wolverines star was getting ice on his ankle and getting it retaped and would return to the game. Ian Eagle later said that Michigan is also checking out Lendeborg's knee. He can't get back soon enough for Michigan.Michigan has led by as many as 16 points, but Arizona has gone on a 11-2 run to pull within seven, which the Wildcats will take after an abysmal start.Koa Peat now leads Arizona with six points. Arizona is on a 7-0 run since Lendeborg exited the game with the injury.Score: Michigan 28, Arizona 21 (7:21 left in first half) Jaden Bradley picks up second foul early for Arizona vs MichiganNow an Arizona player is in foul trouble, and an indispensable one for the Wildcats.Jaden Bradley picked up his second foul with 12:36 left in the first half and exited the game, leaving Arizona's point guard off the floor for the Wildcats.Michigan has taken advantage.A 3-pointer from Yaxel Lendeborg has the Wolverines up 22-10, which matches the largest deficit of the season for Arizona.Arizona is just 4-for-12 from the field. Can it settle down and get something going on offense?Score: Michigan 22, Arizona 10 (11:28 left in first half)How to watch Final Four: Illinois vs UConn | Michigan vs Arizona | UConn vs Illinois TV | Arizona vs Michigan TV | Schedule | TV channels | Game times | Announcers | Who is in Final Four? | Final Four tickets Michigan builds 11-point lead on Arizona in first halfThe Wolverines are running against Arizona.Michigan just took an 11-point lead on the Wildcats with a steal and an emphatic slam by Trey McKenney.Arizona fans likely didn't see this coming.Michigan is 7-for-14 from the field. Arizona is 2-for-8.Aday Maya has a quick six points on 3-for-4 shooting for the Wolvines.Arizona has three points from Jaden Bradley and two from Tobe Awaka off the bench.The Wildcats' super freshmen have looked outclassed early.Score: Michigan 16, Arizona 5 (14:27 left in first half) Michigan off to strong start vs Arizona in Final FourNo Yaxel Lendeborg, no problem?Michigan has been without its star, Yaxel Lendeborg, who picked up two early fouls against Arizona, but it hasn't mattered so far.The Wolverines are off to a fast start against the Wildcats and have a 7-point lead at the first break in action.Michigan is 4-for-10 from the field, but has two early offensive rebounds.Arizona is just 1-for-6 from the field.Score: Michigan 10, Arizona 3 (15:47 left in first half) Michigan star Yaxel Lendeborg picks up two quick fouls vs ArizonaWell, we didn't see this happening.Michigan's Yaxel Lendeborg picked up two fouls in the first 1:22 of the game against Arizona, and had to leave the game.Lendeborg has been huge for Michigan this season, and in the NCAA Tournament.His foul status could be something to monitor all game. What time is the Michigan vs Arizona Final Four game?The Arizona vs Michigan NCAA Tournament Final Four game was scheduled for 5:49 p.m. MST (8:49 p.m. ET) on Saturday, April 4, or 30 minutes after the conclusion of the UConn vs Illinois game.The Final Four decided to push the start back.TBS announced that the game would now be starting at 6:19 p.m. MST (9:19 p.m. ET).Final Four picks: Illinois vs UConn | Michigan vs Arizona | UConn vs Illinois score | Arizona vs Michigan score | The Republic's predictions | Win probabilities Arizona vs Michigan odds flip before start of second Final Four gameWell, this is interesting.Michigan had been a 1.5-point favorite over Arizona since the matchup was determined in the Elite Eight, but the odds have shifted before the second men's Final Four game tonight.Arizona is now a 1.5-point favorite, according to BetMGM Sportsbook. The Wildcats are -115 on the moneyline and the Wolverines are -105.The over/under is set at 157.5 points.DraftKings Sportsbook also now has Arizona as a 1.5-point favorite, with the Wildcats at -112 on the moneyline and the Wolverines at -108. The point total for the game is also at 157.5 in those odds.FanDuel Sportsbook still has Michigan as a 1.5-point favorite, with the Wolverines at -111 on the moneyline and the Wildcats at -108 and the 157.5 point total.Final Four odds: UConn vs Illinois | Arizona vs Michigan | Illinois vs UConn betting | Michigan vs Arizona betting | Betting odds | National championship odds Sign Up Bonus $1,500 Paid Back in Bonus Bets If You Don't WinEasy-to-Use One-Game Parlay BuilderLive Streaming of MLB, NBA & NHLMGM Rewards Program Industry Leader Gambling problem? Who does the Arizona vs Michigan winner play next?We now know one team in the men's national championship game: The UConn Huskies.UConn survived a furious comeback attempt from Illinois, 71-62, to earn the first berth in the March Madness title game on Monday, April 6, where it will face the winner of the Arizona vs Michigan game.The Huskies are attempting to win their third NCAA Tournament in the past four seasons. How can I stream the Michigan vs Arizona Final Four game?Arizona vs Michigan can be streamed on Sling TV and other streaming services that carry TBS. Who are the announcers for the Arizona vs Michigan Final Four game?Ian Eagle will have the play-by-play call of the Michigan Wolverines vs Arizona Wildcats NCAA Tournament game, with Grant Hill and Bill Raftery as the analysts and Tracy Wolfson as the reporter for the March Madness Final Four matchup. What is Arizona vs Michigan point spread in Final Four odds?According to DraftKings Sportsbook, the Michigan Wolverines are a 1.5-point favorite over the Arizona Wildcats in the Final Four round of the NCAA Tournament. What is Michigan vs Arizona moneyline in Final Four odds?DraftKings Sportsbook lists Arizona as +105 on the moneyline for the March Madness NCAA Tournament Final Four game. It has Michigan at -125. What is Arizona vs Michigan over/under in Final Four odds?The point total for the NCAA Tournament March Madness Final Four game between Michigan and Arizona is listed at 157.5 points, per DraftKings Sportsbook.
